about.title: About Intellecta
about.subtitle: A focused learning environment designed to make serious study feel approachable.
about.bio: Intellecta is built around a simple idea: learning becomes more useful when explanations are clear, practice is intentional, and resources are easy to return to. The platform brings these pieces together in one multilingual experience.
about.path: Start with a structured course, strengthen it with practical work, then use supporting resources to revisit the details. Intellecta is designed to give learners room to move from first questions to deeper understanding.

lineage.label: Approach
lineage.value: Clear explanations, practical activities and a steady learning rhythm.

order.label: Languages

speciality.value: Technology, mathematics, sciences, business and languages.

location.label: Experience
location.value: A clean, focused interface designed for comfortable study on any screen.

platform.title: How Intellecta Works
platform.subtitle: A simple learning flow that keeps the next step obvious.
platform.bio: Choose a subject, open a course, learn in focused sections, practise what you have learned, and return to resources when you want more depth. The experience is intentionally straightforward so the interface stays out of the way of the learning.

lineage.label: 01 — Discover
lineage.value: Browse learning areas and choose a course that matches your goal.

order.label: 02 — Learn
order.value: Move through concise, structured lessons at a comfortable pace.

speciality.label: 03 — Practise
speciality.value: Use exercises, projects and supporting material to reinforce ideas.

location.label: 04 — Continue
location.value: Review what matters, explore deeper resources and keep building.

platform.pathTitle: A learning loop that stays simple
platform.path: Discover a topic → learn the core ideas → practise them → review your progress → continue with the next useful challenge. Intellecta keeps this loop visible so learners can spend less energy navigating and more energy learning.
